newsitem.title: USA: Medical Asset sees Q1 profit, 1996 loss.
newsitem.headline: Medical Asset sees Q1 profit, 1996 loss.

text.p: Medical Asset Management Inc said Wednesday that it expects to report a net profit in the first quarter of 1997, but a net loss for 1996 and prior periods.
Preliminary results show the company posted 1996 revenues from management and consulting fees of $26.3 million compared to $13.1 million in 1995, the company said.
For the first quarter of 1997, ended March 31, preliminary results show the company posted revenue of $8 million versus $5.4 million during the same period in the prior year.
Medical Asset said full results will be available once the 1996 audit is completed and restatements of the 1995 and 1994 results are finalized.
Medical Asset is a physician practice management company.
